capabilities: block paste events in Markdown editors
show a notice when pasted text is rejected
disambiguation: Not an originality detector, AI detector, or anti-cheat system; it only prevents normal paste actions inside the Markdown editor.
extras: The README explicitly lists limitations (does not block imports, drag-and-drop, sync, or external automation) and states the plugin makes no network requests or stores no data.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to disable pasting in the editor for writers who want to force manual typing instead of copying text in.
summary: Plugin that blocks paste actions in Markdown editors while enabled, showing a notice when a paste is rejected.
